name: recommended geospatial profile
description: Recommended fields of the World Bank geospatial schema (ISO 19115/19139 based) at each maturity level, as dotted paths, with the reason each field matters. Levels are cumulative. The schema itself requires only description.idno. An office can remove a field from a level, but each removal has the cost named in its reason.

fields.description.idno: The stable identifier for citation and retrieval.
The title shown in search results and answers.
fields.description.identificationInfo.abstract: What the layer contains and its edition; the main text that search reads.
fields.description.identificationInfo.extent.ge: The bounding box; lets a system filter by place and say what area is covered.
fields.description.referenceSystemInfo: The coordinate reference system; a layer without it cannot be used by software.
fields.description.dateStamp: When the record was made; freshness.
fields.description.contact: Who answers questions about the layer.
fields.description.identificationInfo.topicCate: ISO topic category; drives filters and browsing.
fields.description.identificationInfo.resourceC: Access and use constraints, including sensitive locations (chapter 8).
fields.description.identificationInfo.spatialRe: Scale or ground resolution; tells a system what the layer can and cannot support.
fields.description.identificationInfo.resourceM: Update frequency; when to expect a new edition.
fields.description.identificationInfo.language: Language of the data and attributes.
fields.description.distributionInfo.distributio: Formats available (GeoPackage, GeoJSON, COG), so software knows what it will get (chapter 2).
fields.description.distributionInfo.transferOpt: Download links or service endpoints (OGC API Features, WMS) for retrieval (chapter 2).
fields.description.dataQualityInfo: Lineage: where the geometry came from and how it was processed (chapter 5).
fields.description.metadataStandardName: Names the standard the record follows, for harvesters.
fields.description.feature_catalogue: Attribute definitions and code lists; the meaning of the columns (chapter 3).
fields.description.identificationInfo.serviceId: Describes the OGC services that serve the layer, for agents and tools.
fields.description.contentInfo: Band or coverage description for rasters.
